name: sqlite-zod-orm
description: Type-safe SQLite ORM for Bun — Zod schemas, fluent queries, auto relationships, zero SQL

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target bun --format esm && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && bun scripts/fix-dts-extensions.ts
scripts.bench: bun bench/triggers-vs-naive.ts && bun bench/poll-strategy.ts && bun bench/indexes.ts
scripts.test:types: bun run build && bun run scripts/check-package-types.ts
scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && bun test && bun run test:types

author: 7flash
